topic: Why mortgage rates jumped past 7 percent
hook: Mortgage rates just hit seven point four percent.
cta: Follow for more money myths, explained.

captions.hook_line: Mortgage rates just hit 7.4%. Most people blame the Fed, but the Fed doesn't set your mortgage rate 🏠
captions.body: Lenders price 30-year mortgages off the 10-year Treasury yield plus a margin. That yield hit about 5.36% in October, its highest since 2002, and the 30-year average reached 7.40% (Freddie Mac, Oct 15).
captions.share_line: Send this to a friend who's house hunting.

youtube_title: Mortgage Rates Hit 7.4%. It's Not the Fed

sources.claim: Freddie Mac 30-year fixed average 7.40% for the week of Oct 15, 2026, flat from Oct 8 and up from 7.28% on Oct 1
The 30-year average was 6.34% a year earlier
The 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.3645% in October 2026, its highest since April 2002
Mortgage rates track the 10-year Treasury yield plus a spread rather than the Fed's short-term rate
On a 30-year $400,000 loan, monthly principal and interest is about $2,770 at 7.40% versus $2,486 at 6.34%, about $283 more (standard amortization formula)

visual_style: Photorealistic cinematic film still, natural daylight, real materials and textures, shallow depth of field

blocks.narration: Mortgage rates just hit seven point four percent. Most people blame the Fed, but the Fed doesn't set your mortgage rate.
blocks.visual: Close-up of a young woman in a denim jacket holding a set of house keys in front of a suburban house, staring at her phone in shock

shots.visual: Close-up of a young woman in a denim jacket holding a set of house keys in front of a suburban house, staring at her phone in shock
shots.action: Her jaw drops and the keys slip from her fingers; the camera crash zooms into her wide eyes

shots.visual: A crowd of frustrated homebuyers on the marble steps of a grand neoclassical government building with tall white columns
shots.action: They shake their fists and point up at the columns; the camera cranes up the facade

shots.visual: A man's hand in a dark suit sleeve resting on a blank mortgage contract on a polished wooden desk
shots.action: The hand lifts off the paper and pulls away out of frame, leaving the contract alone; the camera pushes in on it

blocks.narration: Lenders price thirty-year loans off the ten-year Treasury yield, plus a margin. In October that yield hit its highest level since two thousand two.
blocks.visual: A loan officer at a bank desk with a large dark wall screen behind him showing a single glowing green line

shots.visual: A loan officer in a white shirt at a bank desk, a large dark wall screen behind him showing a single glowing green line
shots.action: The green line climbs steeply across the screen; he glances back at it and grimaces; the camera pushes in

shots.visual: Traders on a busy stock exchange floor staring up at a giant dark screen where a single red line spikes toward the top
shots.action: The red line shoots up off the top of the screen and the traders' heads tilt up in disbelief; the camera cranes up

blocks.narration: On a four hundred thousand dollar loan, seven point four percent costs about two hundred eighty dollars more a month than last year's rate.
blocks.visual: The young woman in the denim jacket at her kitchen table with a calculator and a small model house

shots.visual: The young woman in the denim jacket at her kitchen table with a calculator beside a small wooden model house
shots.action: She punches numbers into the calculator, then her eyebrows shoot up and she leans back; the camera pushes in

shots.visual: A big glass jar full of coins and rolled-up cash on a kitchen counter next to a small wooden model house
shots.action: A hand scoops a heavy handful of coins out of the jar and they spill and bounce across the counter; the camera tracks the spill

blocks.narration: So when the ten-year yield climbs, mortgage rates follow, Fed or no Fed. Follow for more money myths, explained.
blocks.visual: Two hot-air balloons rising over a suburban neighborhood at sunrise, the second tethered to the first by a long rope

shots.visual: Two hot-air balloons rising over a suburban neighborhood at sunrise, the second tethered to the first by a long rope
shots.action: The first balloon surges upward and the rope snaps taut, yanking the second balloon up after it; the camera cranes up

shots.visual: The young woman in the denim jacket standing in front of the suburban house, house keys in her hand
shots.action: She tosses the keys in the air, catches them and gives a knowing smile to the camera; the camera pulls back to show the street
